title: GTA 6 broke every record before it even launched 🤯 #GTA6
description: 6.5 million people watching at once, 40 billion views before release, a 13-year wait: the wildest numbers from the GTA 6 launch.

scenes.label: people watching live at the same time
scenes.voice: Six and a half million people. That's how many viewers were watching GTA 6 live, at the same time, on launch day. An all-time record for a video game.
The craziest part? At that moment, the game wasn't even out in Europe yet. It had only just unlocked in New Zealand.

scenes.label: viewers on a single Twitch stream
scenes.voice: The biggest stream, from Russian streamer HoneyMad, hit five hundred seventy-five thousand viewers on Twitch.

scenes.label: for IShowSpeed on YouTube
scenes.voice: And IShowSpeed pulled in more than two hundred thirty-seven thousand people at once on YouTube.

scenes.label: YouTube views before release
scenes.voice: Before it even came out, GTA 6 videos had already racked up forty billion views on YouTube.

scenes.label: views for the whole GTA series
scenes.voice: And the whole GTA series has passed nine hundred billion views on the platform.
YouTube even ran a twenty-four hour livestream for the launch, like it was the Super Bowl.
Meanwhile, Kick is giving away ten thousand copies of the game to viewers who watch three hours of streams.
No surprise: fans have been waiting since GTA 5 came out in twenty thirteen. That's thirteen years.
Did you watch the launch live? Tell me in the comments, and follow for more.
